resolved.title: Python 数据科学
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Python for Data Science[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Python[/b] is the #1 programming language for Data Science, and for good reason:

 - Python is easy to learn.
 - The syntax is easy to read and understand.
 - There are many useful libraries to perform computations and other operations.

[note]Generally, Python code is also much shorter compared to other programming languages.[/note]

content.text:
**Python**是数据科学的第一编程语言，原因：

 - Python上手轻松简单。
 - 语法简洁，容易阅读和理解。
 - 丰富的第三方库专门用于数据处理及可视化
content.text_html:
Python is the #1 programming language for Data Science, and for good reason:

  • Python is easy to learn.
  • The syntax is easy to read and understand.
  • There are many useful libraries to perform computations and other operations.

Python是数据科学的第一大编程语言，这是有原因的。

  • Python很容易学习。
  • 语法很容易阅读和理解。
  • 有许多有用的库来进行计算和其他操作。

content.text: 一般来说，相比其他编程语言，Python代码简短优雅。
